portal.value: NYU Pre-Screen Artistic Portal for Dance (personalized link emailed after the Common App is submitted — not Acceptd/SlideRoom)
portal.note: Page (2026-2027 cycle): "After the application is submitted, NYU Undergraduate Admissions will send an email with instructions for auditioning," and refers applicants to the "Pre-Screen Artistic Portal for Dance," which opens early October.

fee.note: Artistic-review fee not captured — checked both application-requirements and admissions-FAQ pages on 2026-08-11; no fee amount is published on either. Still needs verification (possibly stated only inside the portal itself or via email).

prescreenRequired.note: 2026-2027 cycle deadlines page still requires the Pre-Screen/Artistic Review submission ahead of any callback.

value.text: Recorded audition class — ballet (center work, no barre) + contemporary. No jazz/commercial section.

videoSpec.note: Class-video link expires 3 hours after opening. Dept. seeks 3+ years ballet/contemporary training (this training requirement re-confirmed 2026-08-11). The application-requirements page no longer itemizes the checklist directly — it defers to a separate "How To: Tisch Dance Pre-Screen and Callbacks" page (not in sources[]); the resume/photo/audition-form items above could not be re-verified this pass and should get a manual spot-check.

auditions.label: In-person callback — NY / LA / Chicago
auditions.city: New York (111 Second Ave), Los Angeles (OCSA), or Chicago (Chicago Academy for the Arts)

date.note: Callback dates are round-specific, so no single value is set here: ED1 callback Nov 13, 2026; ED2 callback Jan 19, 2027; RD callbacks Jan 30 – Feb 6, 2027 (2026-2027 cycle, entering Fall 2027). Must schedule within 48h of prescreen-pass notification.

auditions.time: Morning sessions, typically 9:00 AM–12:00 PM ET; arrive 30 minutes before start time.
auditions.notes: Prescreen-gated. Ballet + contemporary class, improvisation, solo up to 2 min (no pointe solos), faculty interview. Locations confirmed 2026-08-11: New York (111 Second Ave), Los Angeles (OCSA), Chicago (Chicago Academy for the Arts).

auditions.label: Virtual callback

date.note: Arranged for those who cannot attend in person — email tisch.dance@nyu.edu. Page (2026-2027 cycle) confirms a virtual option exists alongside NY/LA/Chicago in-person callbacks, but does not publish a standalone virtual-session date.

auditions.notes: Solo video up to 2 min + video response to an improvisation prompt + Zoom interview. Key option for a San Juan applicant.
